---
title: "Lightbox: options without match"
# bd-kcpkgftw. The object form without `match: auto` keeps explicit mode:
# only `.lightbox` images are wrapped, but the options still apply.
lightbox:
  effect: none
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'a.lightbox[href="images/mv-1.png"] > img'
        - - 'a.lightbox[href="images/mv-0.png"]'
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - "\"closeEffect\":\"none\",\"openEffect\":\"none\""
        - []
---

![Not wrapped](images/mv-0.png)

![Wrapped](images/mv-1.png){.lightbox}
